title: Eric Henry Wang's name on DTIC engineering documents

tellings.quote: yes he no he he existed he existed if you look through the DTick the defense technical information center you can find actual um you can find uh old engineering documents with air Henry weighing on it

plain: A man named Eric Henry Wang, whose name the stories link to Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio in the 1950s, was a real engineer, according to a researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb. He tells Michels that you can search DTIC, the Defense Technical Information Center that keeps the military's technical reports, and find old engineering documents with Wang's name on them. He quotes nothing from them. The documents would show that Wang existed and worked on defence engineering, but they leave open whether he did any of the secret work the stories give him.
